summary: {person} asks agencies to speed up a program that keeps a federal inspector at each site.
realLife: Carter called for faster deployment of resident inspectors to nuclear plants in response to the commission's findings.
gates: An agency has authority to assign inspectors to the site.
weights: Repeated inspections at the same site favor a resident posting.
inGame: needs: the posting and coverage of inspectors.

turns.what: Inspectors continue to visit from a regional office.
turns.pulledBy: The agency denies funding for a permanent post.
turns.writesBack: The inspection calendar lists visits without a resident assignment.

turns.what: A resident inspector arrives after a temporary rotation.
turns.pulledBy: The permanent appointee must finish another assignment.
turns.writesBack: The staffing record gives the rotation and handover dates.
